prompt: Build for this brief: A software product; users scan records and complete repeated tasks. Use Spectrum 1-5: page #19161D, text #F6F3F7, accent #E58AB4, secondary surface #373725, text on accent #111111. Set headings in EB Garamond and reading text in Cotham Sans; literary heading with understated sans text. Composition: One dominant feature with smaller supporting entries, staggered hierarchy, linear mobile reading order. Use body 20px, heading 28px, line height 1.3, reading measure at most 60ch, gap 48px, content width at most 1280px and item radius 4px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
